ARCHITECTURE.md — js/crowd.js, the Horde crowd engine (1.4.0, P4). Draft for P10 to fold into §6 (module contracts), §5 (events),
§8 (data) and §9 (rendering). Everything here is implemented in r8/P4; P6 (hold.js) builds on it.
==========================================================================================================================

§6.x crowd.js — ctx.crowd (CrowdSystem; SYSTEMS weight 10, after zombies; imports three, util, data only)

LIFECYCLE
- init(): allocates the SoA pool (CROWD.slots 3,072), the 1 m grid (24 × 82 cells), the spawn queue (CROWD.queueCap 16,384:
  a whole hold, ≤ 13,500 units) with spawnSurge's batch scratch, and the data texture's CPU side (1024 × 4 RGBA32F = 64 KB)
  once. No GPU work, nothing in the scene.
- prepare() → Promise: builds the meshes once (a hidden Group 'crowd' under render.scene: LOD0, LOD1, LOD2, carpet, pierce
  streaks, gore ring; LOD0's customDepthMaterial), registers them with render.addWarmable and resolves when every program of
  the committed tier is compiled and drawn once: 7 programs on shadow-map tiers (High, Medium: the LOD0 depth program; casters only on High), 6 on Low / software GL (measured: 58 → 65 at High and Medium).
  programsReady is false until then. Being scene members, the meshes are part of every later tier change (_prepareTier) and
  context-restore warm-up, so nothing compiles during play. Without a renderer (node) it resolves at once.
- begin(o { seed, coin, rules, priority }): starts a hold — reset(), both RNG streams reseeded from seed (gameplay and looks),
  coin = coins per paying kill (crowd:kills), rules = setRules(rules), the governor reference taken (median frame interval of
  the last CROWD.governor.refS s while a level played, never below engine.frameTargetMs = max(refresh, 16.67 ms)), the Group shown, and the crowd registered as a weapons target
  (weapons.addTarget(this, priority)). Call it at the dig-in: weapons.reset (every level start, RESTART, QUIT) drops providers.
  If prepare() never ran, begin() builds the meshes synchronously (programs then compile on the first draw).
- flee(): the hold is won — every living unit turns (mode FLEE: walks away at CROWD.field.fleeK × its speed, released past
  fleeZ), the queue is dropped, the carpet fades over CROWD.carpet.fade s. Until the next begin(): every provider query misses
  (no round, blast or troop is spent on the crowd; the target stays registered and alive stays the living count), a kill of a
  fleeing unit pays nothing and counts nowhere (crowd.kills, crowd.bites, crowd:kills), and queue / spawnSurge / spawnBurst
  refuse (false / 0).
- reset() (RESET_ORDER, level start / quit) and end(): inactive, pool and queue cleared, the gore ring and the pierce streaks
  emptied (no blood of the last attempt at the next dig-in), Group hidden, weapons target removed, engine.scalerGuard back to
  { 0, true }, the debug demo's level patch removed. Cheap when already idle.
- dispose(): also removes the Group and the warmable and frees every GPU object.
- active false: step() returns at once; render() only samples frame intervals while a level plays (the governor reference).

SIMULATION (identical on every tier: the tier only changes what is drawn)
- Cadence: step(dt) at 60 Hz alternates phase A and phase B (each tick = 2 steps, 30 Hz):
  A: release finished deaths (CROWD.render.deathS on the crowd clock), the feed, the counting sort, separation.
  B: the rules' begin(dt), every listed living unit nearest-first (rows from the wall backward): mode motion, clamps, rule
     callbacks, the per-column front cache, view culling, the drawn order; dying bodies merged by depth; the pack; the carpet;
     rules.end(dt); crowd:kills.
- The crowd clock crowd.t (s since begin) drives the queue and deaths; deathT / hitT for the shaders use ctx.time.elapsed.
- Feed: due queue entries FIFO (the queue is kept in time order: tail insertion for queue(), one backward merge for a surge). A burst entry (explicit z) is placed there
  while alive < feedCap + reserve; any other at a random z of the band CROWD.field.feedZ, x = its x (then ±3 m tries, ≤ feedTries)
  where the 1 m cell holds < feedDens (last tick's counts, like holdsim). No room or alive ≥ feedCap: it WAITS (the head
  blocks; ctx.debug.dropped['crowd.wait'] counts each waiting unit once). ≤ feedPerTick spawns per tick.
- Motion (WALK / WALL / PASS / FLEE): x steers toward tx with the zone gain (street / funnel / wall), sideways diffusion into
  thinner cells, forward at the unit's speed (type speed × (1 ± speedJitter)), crawlers lunge (lunge[1] m/s) in the last
  lunge[0] m; crowd pressure: the cell ahead above densCap slows the unit to the cell's mean speed + 0.3, above 2 × densCap
  stops it. 1.4.0 change vs horde-v6 / holdsim2: within 1 m of its barrier line a unit's OWN cell counts as the cell ahead, and
  a cell above 2 × densCap pushes its units back at relief m/s per extra unit — without that the wall row stacked up to 290
  units per 1 m cell in a 30 s peak (tools/zdist.mjs; holdsim2 has the same stacking). Now ≤ 10-11 per cell and the pile
  queues back up the funnel. Velocity eases at accel; separation displacement × sep.k; the funnel clamps x (|x| ≤ halfAt(z) − r,
  ≤ wallHalf − r past the wall and in PASS); WALK / WALL units are clamped at wallZ(x) − r.
- Separation: every unit against the next sep.max units of its own cell, the first sep.max of its right neighbour and
  3 × sep.max of the next row's cells, skipping a neighbour cell when the unit is farther than 2r from it (exact: the lists
  are built in the same phase). Linear in a crowded cell, so stacks always come apart.
- Determinism: node tools/parity.mjs and hordeperf4 --mode life: same seed + same fire → identical checksum on high / med /
  low / sw, with and without rules.

MODES (crowd.MODE; crowd.mode[i], written by rules)
  WALK 0 steering / pressure / clamps · WALL 1 the same, the rule's 'at the wall' marker · CLIMB 2 z += field.climbSpeed per
  s, no clamps, reachZ → onReach · PASS 3 through a breach: x ≤ wallHalf − r, no wall clamp, reachZ → onReach · HOLD 4 no
  motion (spitter holding, brute at the line) · FLEE 5 (flee()).

RULES HOOK — setRules(r) or begin({ rules }); every member optional, called inside phase B with direct SoA access
  begin(dt) / end(dt)   once per tick (dt = 2 steps), before / after the unit pass
  wallZ(x)              the barrier line at x (default CROWD.field.wallZ −3.9); asked for units within 3 m of the default line
  onWall(i)             a WALK / WALL unit was clamped at its line this tick (z = wallZ − r, vz 0): claw slots, piles, climbs,
                        breach tokens (set mode CLIMB / PASS; for PASS nudge z past the line)
  onClimb(i)            a CLIMB unit after it moved;  onBreach(i) a PASS unit after it moved
  onReach(i)            a CLIMB / PASS unit at or past r.reachZ (default CROWD.field.reachZ −2.57): bite (kill(i, 'bite')) or
                        hold (mode HOLD); without the function the unit bites and dies ('bite', no coins)
  spitHold(i)           a WALK spitter at or past r.spitZ (default CROWD.field.spitZ −19.6), every tick until its mode changes
  onHold(i)             a HOLD unit, every tick (lob timers, brute swings)
  r.reachZ, r.spitZ     numbers read each tick
  SoA (Float32 unless noted; index = slot i): x, z, vx, vz, spd, hp, tx (target x), tm, aw (free for the rules), type (Uint8,
  ZOMBIES.common.types order), mode (Uint8), state (Uint8: 0 free, 1 alive, 2 dying), live (Int32 list) / nLive.
  Calls: kill(i, cause) (crumple; 'bite' | 'cleanup' | 'flee' and a FLEE unit pay nothing, 'bite' counts crowd.bites), remove(i) (no body),
  idOf(i) / slotOf(id). Pile counts read inside the same pass are one tick old by construction (as holdsim).

SPAWNING
- queue(t, type, x, tx, hp, z?) → bool: one unit due at crowd time t (type = index or name); z given = a burst at (x, z). It
  goes after the queued units due at the same time (times compared as stored, float32); O(1) in time order, O(later entries)
  otherwise. False when the type is unknown, the queue is full (warnOnce) or after flee().
- spawnSurge(d) → queued: d { t0 (s from now), window, n, type or mix [5 weights], hp (number or [5]), x0, x1 (spawn x at the
  window start), x0e, x1e (at its end: sweeps), tx0, tx1, pA + ta0, ta1 (chance of a second target range) }; stratified times,
  so the batch is time-ordered and merges into the queue in one backward pass (O(queued + n); the same order and draws as n
  queue() calls; a full queue keeps the first entries, the draws go on). Measured: 3,000 among a 1,200-entry trickle 0.3-1.2 ms.
- spawnBurst(x, z, n, type, hp, spread) → placed now: boss minions within spread m around / behind (x, z) on the reserve;
  overflow waits as burst entries.
- pushCircle(x, z, r): units inside r + their radius pushed out radially (the boss footprint, per tick).
- Counters: alive (living), aliveOfType(t), queued (all entries), waiting (due entries still waiting), kills, bites.

TARGET PROVIDER (weapons ARCH §3 contract)
- alive (getter; 0 skips the provider everywhere). After flee() every query below misses (applyHit returns the damage).
- hitTestSeg(seg, radius, out { id, x, y, z, t }): nearest hittable unit whose capsule (CROWD.units[t].hitR) meets the swept
  segment; a per-column front cache (max z of the living per 1 m column, built in phase B) rejects segments in front of
  every unit at once; y = min(FIRE.bullet.y, unit height).
- applyHit(id, damage, pierceMax, x, y, z, cause) → leftover: the unit takes min(damage, hp); a kill carries the leftover to
  the next hittable unit BEHIND it in the same 1 m grid column (≤ pierceMax units, never past CROWD.field.rangeZ −44.3);
  a pierce draws a streak from the first to the last unit hit. Rounds into an empty column are the caller's (wasted).
- damageInCircle(x, z, r, amount, cause), damageInLine(x, z0, halfWidth, amount, cause, maxTargets, zMin) (nearest first when
  maxTargets is finite), damageInCone(x, z, dirX, dirZ, halfAngle, range, amount, cause) → kills.
- nearest(x, z, out), nearestOfType(typeName, x, z, out) → bool, out { id, x, y, z }; highestHp(out) (+ out.hp; z < 0);
  densestCell(x0, x1, z0, z1, out { x, z, n }) (the last sort's counts; ties to the wall).
- Crawlers below CROWD.units.crawler.hitZ (−14) are skipped by every bullet-height query (hitTestSeg, pierce, lines).
- Hit flash at most once per CROWD.render.flashCool s, never on the killing hit.

RENDERING
- Data texture 1024 × 4 RGBA32F, 2 texels per drawn instance slot (x, z, vx, vz | phase, look, deathT, hitT), written by the
  phase-B pack and uploaded whole (65,536 B) on ticks that draw; look packs variant | gait << 2 | bright << 6 | type << 10 |
  fade << 13. The shaders texelFetch (gl_InstanceID · K + aCopy) and extrapolate x / z with the velocity between ticks
  (uSince ≤ 0.1 s; pause: uSince frozen, no drift).
- Drawn set: living units in the view (horizontal frustum + 1 m), nearest first, up to floor(governorCap × (1 − dyingReserve));
  dying bodies in view, nearest 1 m row first (a counting sort, like the living), take what remains of the cap, merged into the
  order by depth (so a kill at the wall stays LOD0). LOD0 = the first ≤ tier.lod0 units nearer than lod0Z; the cross-fade band = its last min(xfade, n0 / 2) slots, which
  LOD1 draws from the same texels (fade q in LOD0 = coverage q / 15, in LOD1 = 1 − q / 15; complementary 4×4 Bayer: no pixel
  in both); LOD1 to lod1Z; LOD2 beyond. High: the nearest min(n0, shadows) LOD0 units cast through the customDepthMaterial.
- Every LOD draws the walker body (LOD0 = models.geo.walker + a ground disc; LOD1 = a 68-tri body in the same −Z-facing model
  space): per type scale / crawler pitch about the hip / limb swing and arm rest / gait range / palette from scalar uniforms
  with a select (no uniform arrays). Arms rise while a unit is blocked (speed → 0). Units face their velocity biased toward the
  wall (yaw = atan(vx, vz + 0.6) + π), dying ones face the camera.
- Shading: sun + hemisphere (× 1/π like three's standard materials) + view fill (fill[0] × sun + fill[1] × sky toward the
  camera), copied from render.lights EVERY frame (so lightsVersion changes are covered too). Body colour ≤ render.bodyMax 0.9
  linear; eyes = eye.color × hdr, full only for z > eye.nearZ, × eye.band (0.56: under the bloom threshold) by bandZ, × far by
  farZ; carpet eyes × carpet; spitter torso glows (render.sac) on the same ramp. Measured (float target, crowd alone): max 0.84
  outside the eye band, 1.5 inside.
- The ground disc (part 9) draws under every unit that casts no shadow: on High the first min(n0, shadows) LOD0 instances (the
  casters, while the sun casts) drop it, and so do their LOD1 copies in the cross-fade band (uNoDisc per material: LOD0 = casters,
  LOD1 = casters − xf0); LOD0 beyond the casters, LOD1 and every unit on Medium / Low / software keep it. The depth material
  never draws it.
- Software GL (fixed per session): LOD0 / LOD1 are built without the dither discard (no cross-fade band, no dither-out; the
  crumple sinks the body instead) — the discard cost SwiftShader its early depth test, ≈ 9 ms a frame at 1024×594.
- Carpet: tier.carpetRows instanced rows of fragment-drawn silhouettes from its front to carpet.back; density
  clamp((queued + undrawn + d0) / d1, d2, 1) × the fade-in / fade-out weight (0 before the first unit, after flee()); front =
  carpet.front, or while the cap binds clamp(z of the farthest drawn living unit − 1, front, nearest), eased at carpet.ease.
- Gore ring (tier.gore of 256 allocated) at kills nearer than gore.maxZ (rngFx); pierce streaks (tracers.cap) additive.
- Draws while active: LOD0, LOD1, LOD2, carpet, streaks, gore = 6 main (+1 shadow on High); measured main 27-28 in the demo
  hold vs 32 RUN at High, shadow 9 vs 9-11.
- Tier change (quality:change): the tier row (caps, LOD bands, casters, carpet rows, gore ring) and the governor restart at the
  tier's cap (logged as 'crowd:governor' during a hold);
  no reallocation (same texture, buffers and geometries), programs prepared by render's tier compile (min == max measured).

GOVERNOR AND THE AUTO-SCALER (render(), per frame, while active; never on software GL, whose cap is fixed)
- Reference: the median frame interval of the run phase's last refS s (the engine's sustained interval before 10 samples), never
  below engine.frameTargetMs = max(refresh, 16.67 ms) — as the auto-scaler: a 90 / 120 Hz panel holding 60 fps is on target
  (without the floor a 120 Hz phone at 87 fps stepped 2,048 → 1,024).
- EMA of the frame interval (governor.ema; hitches > hitchMs ignored). Above up × reference for upS s: cap × down (≥ tier
  floor); at ≤ raise × reference for raiseS s: cap × (1 + step) (≤ tier cap). Each step emits 'crowd:governor'
  { cap, living = floor(cap × (1 − dyingReserve)), floor, ref } — the on-screen probe compares LIVING drawn with 0.95 × living.
- engine.scalerGuard.exemptMs = the crowd's step ms of the frame; dropOk = the cap has sat at the floor ≥ dropOkS s (software GL:
  its fixed cap counts as the floor). reset() restores { 0, true }.

DEBUG API (?debug=1; D46 fallback 2 may move it to js/debugtools.js)
- debugDemo({ alive, queued, seed }) → bool: a synthetic hold on the running level for measurement — the level's step is parked
  (an own-property shadow, removed by reset()), road stopped, invulnerable, run zombies / gates / crates cleared, the wall
  formation, rig 'hold', a lane-sweeping fire policy (90 rounds/s, out-of-lane × 0.25, pierce 4) at the crowd; `alive` walkers
  / runners inside 40 m (denser toward the wall, ≤ 4 per cell) and `queued` in the band, topped up every tick.
- stats() → { tier, alive, waiting, queued, kills, bites, drawn [LOD0, LOD1-only, LOD2], drawnTotal, drawn40 (living within
  40 m), drawnDying, culled, undrawn, carpetFront, governorCap, livingCap, floor, reference, dropOk, shadowCasters, tickA, tickB,
  stepMean, stepP95, stepMax, renderMs, uploads, uploadBytes } (allocates). debugReset() zeroes the perf window.
- debugGovernor(dir) → cap: one forced governor step (logged like a real one). debugMeshes → { lod0, lod1, lod2, carpet, depth,
  tracers, gore, tex }. crowd.perf: the raw counters and the 4,096-step ring of step ms.

§5 events
| crowd:kills | { n, coins, x, z } — n paying kills since the last batch, coins = n × coin, x / z their mean (≤ CROWD.killsHz) | crowd | fx (coalesced), level / hold (coins), audio cues |
| crowd:governor | { cap, living, floor, ref } on every governor step (real or debugGovernor) and at a tier change during a hold | crowd | probes, debug |

§8 data — CROWD (js/data.js region 'CROWD (P4)'): slots, feedCap, reserve, queueCap, grid, field (wallZ, wallHalf, throatZ,
funnelZ, streetHalf, feedZ, feedDens, feedX, feedTries, feedPerTick, reachZ, spitZ, rangeZ, climbSpeed, fleeK, fleeZ), radius,
steer (street, funnel, wall, max, diffuse, accel, densCap, relief), sep (max, k, zMin), speedJitter, units (per type: speed,
hitR, height, gait, leg, arm, armRest, bob, scale, crawler pitch / lift / hitZ / lunge), tiers (high / med / low / sw: cap,
lod0, lod0Z, lod1Z, shadows, carpetRows, gore, floor), dyingReserve 0.1 (A13(b)), xfade, near40, governor, render, eye,
palette, carpet, gore, tracers, killsHz. Values only for P9; the unit speeds live here (the hold's runtime keys are P6's).
